in_arabic.name: Kharaman
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني The Praised One
in_arabic.long_meaning: Kharaman هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'Kharama' which means 'to praise' or 'to be praised'. In Islamic tradition, the name 'Kharaman' symbolizes the praise of Allah and the acknowledgement of His greatness.
